shortDesc: Agent Graph Orchestration Language — a custom DSL, compiler, runtime, and IDE extension for multi-agent systems.
fullDesc:
A custom programming language designed from scratch for building and orchestrating systems made up of multiple intelligent agents.

Rather than gluing existing frameworks together, this project involved designing the language itself — its grammar, its rules, how programs written in it get compiled, and how they ultimately run.

Includes a compiler written in OCaml, a Python runtime execution engine, a published PyPI package (orch-lib), and a TypeScript-based VS Code extension published to the VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX Registry.
highlights: Compiler written in OCaml with Lexer, Parser, Semantic Analysis, and Code Generation
Python-based runtime execution engine (orch-lib) distributed on PyPI
TypeScript VS Code Extension live on the Marketplace and Open VSX with full syntax highlighting, hover documentation, and auto-completion
Full public user documentation site deployed and versioned

reports.title: ORCH Project Report
reports.desc: Comprehensive engineering log: architecture, compiler stages, runtime design, and VS Code extension integrations.

subRepoOverviews.orch-lib: A Python execution engine runtime package distributed on PyPI. It handles the compiled AST output, schedules tasks, routes agent messages, and executes state-space steps for multi-agent workflows.
subRepoOverviews.orch-vscode-extension: A TypeScript-based VS Code extension published to the VS Code Marketplace, providing rich editor features (lexer-matched syntax highlighting, snippets, diagnostics, and hovering).
subRepoOverviews.documentation-aeon: Markdown source files and layouts of the compiler user documentation site, describing the language syntax, installation guides, and multi-agent compile targets.
